jobs.name: Daily Morning Briefing - Personal Tasks
jobs.prompt:
You are preparing Zeus's Daily Morning Briefing for Duy.

Purpose: compact, plan-first personal/life-admin briefing. Exclude stocks, market news, horoscope, quotes, moon phase, and filler. Use America/Vancouver local date/time unless active travel context says otherwise.

Gather:
1. Run `python3 /home/hermes/.hermes/profiles/zeus/scripts/generate_daily_plan.py`.
2. Read `/vault/Tasks/planning/YYYY-MM-DD.md` for today. It is authoritative for Fixed, Today Tasks, Review Block, and Top 3.
3. Read Catthew's latest family briefing output from `/home/hermes/.hermes/profiles/catthew/cron/output/c729ba85e251/` if available; extract Victoria/family/daycare/appointment items only.
4. Read today's `/vault/Daily/YYYY-MM-DD.md`, else the latest Daily note, for personal context only.
5. Read `/home/hermes/.hermes/profiles/zeus/task_buttons/registry.json` if it exists; do not present done/deleted cards as pending.

Rules:
- `## Today Tasks` is the complete authoritative list of due-today non-fixed tasks. Never replace it with future tasks.
- `## Fixed` is the complete authoritative list of fixed-time/specific-time items. Never invent fixed appointments.
- Victoria pickup / pickup transition is weekday-only (Monday–Friday). On Saturday/Sunday, do not mention a 2:45 PM pickup unless it is present as a dated source event in the generated Fixed section or family briefing.
- Weekends are family-first: no Pomodoro schedule, no Company Review; use Investment Portfolio Review only.
- Weekdays: before 9:00 AM family/baby; brunch 10:00–10:30; 2:35–2:45 pickup transition; after 2:45 family-first. Specific-time tasks stay under Fixed, never in Pomodoro.
- Company review rotation: Monday SalonX, Tuesday Sans Souci/SS, Wednesday Ongles Rivieres, Thursday Ongles Maily, Friday Ongles Charlesbourg.
- Strip Obsidian markup: `[[Page|label]]` → `label`; remove raw tags/backticks/metadata.

Output Telegram-readable plaintext only:

Today — YYYY-MM-DD

Fixed
- [every item from Fixed, or None]

Today Tasks
- [every item from Today Tasks, or None]

Review Block
- 11:45–12:15 — [Company Review weekday / Investment Portfolio Review weekend]

Top 3
1. [generated plan]
2. ...
3. ...

Weekday Pomodoro Schedule (omit entirely Saturday/Sunday)
- 9:00–9:05 — Daily setup
- 9:05–9:30 — Pomodoro 1 — Deep Work
- 9:30–9:35 — Break
- 9:35–10:00 — Pomodoro 2 — Deep Work
- 10:00–10:30 — Brunch
- 10:30–10:55 — Pomodoro 3 — Deep Work
- 10:55–11:00 — Break
- 11:00–11:25 — Pomodoro 4 — Deep Work
- 11:25–11:45 — Buffer / Messages
- 11:45–12:15 — Review Block
- 12:15–12:40 — Pomodoro 5 — Admin / Finance
- 12:40–1:00 — Buffer / Reset
- 1:00–1:25 — Pomodoro 6 — Deep Work
- 1:25–1:30 — Break
- 1:30–1:55 — Pomodoro 7 — Deep Work / Review
- 2:15–2:35 — Exercise + shutdown

Decisions Needed
- [only when required]

Do not append task titles or assignments to any schedule line. Do not dump overdue tasks.

jobs.name: Weekly Finance-Investment Knowledge Trade
jobs.prompt:
You are Zeus coordinating the weekly knowledge trade between Duy's Finance Advisor profile (`finance`) and Investment Strategist profile (`charles`). This job is intended for every Saturday at 11:00 PM Vancouver/PDT time.

Do not schedule any new cron jobs.

Goal: have Finance Advisor and Investment Strategist exchange useful context, then send Duy a compact summary.

Steps:
1. Ask Finance Advisor for a weekly finance/admin summary by running a one-shot Hermes command via terminal:
   `hermes --profile finance chat -q "Weekly knowledge trade for Duy. Summarize finance/admin context the Investment Strategist should know: upcoming payments, credit card actions, tax/debt/insurance deadlines, cash constraints, risk limits, and any finance tasks due soon. Keep it concise, factual, no investment advice."`
2. Ask Investment Strategist for a weekly investment summary by running:
   `hermes --profile charles chat -q "Weekly knowledge trade for Duy. Summarize investment/portfolio context the Finance Advisor should know: portfolio allocation concerns, planned trades/rebalances, cash needs, risk exposures, watchlist items, and upcoming investment decisions. Keep it concise. Include disclaimer only if giving analysis."`
3. Send Finance Advisor's summary to Investment Strategist with:
   `hermes --profile charles chat -q "Finance Advisor weekly context for Duy: [PASTE FINANCE SUMMARY]. Incorporate this into your context for future portfolio/investment guidance. Reply with only key implications for investment planning."`
4. Send Investment Strategist's summary to Finance Advisor with:
   `hermes --profile finance chat -q "Investment Strategist weekly context for Duy: [PASTE INVPSTMENT SUMMARY]. Incorporate this into your context for future finance/admin reminders. Reply with only key implications for cashflow, deadlines, or admin tasks."`
5. Final message to Duy: compact bullets only:
   - `💰 Finance shared:` top 2-3 items
   - `📈 Investment shared:` top 2-3 items
   - `🔁 Cross-agent implications:` top 2-3 action-relevant implications
   - `⚠️ Needs Duy:` only if a decision/action is needed

Keep final under 12 bullets. No tables. No raw logs.

jobs.name: Daily Evening Briefing - Task Status
jobs.prompt:
You are preparing Zeus's Daily Evening Briefing for Duy at 9:00PM Vancouver/Pacific time.

Purpose: tomorrow builder + task status. No stocks, headlines, weather, horoscope, quote, or long commentary.

Use America/Vancouver local date/time unless active travel context says otherwise.

Gather:
1. Read today's `/vault/Tasks/planning/YYYY-MM-DD.md` if it exists.
2. Generate tomorrow's plan by running: `python3 /home/hermes/.hermes/profiles/zeus/scripts/generate_daily_plan.py --tomorrow`.
3. Read tomorrow's `/vault/Tasks/planning/YYYY-MM-DD.md`.
4. Read `/home/hermes/.hermes/profiles/zeus/task_buttons/registry.json` if it exists. Interpret `done` as completed, `sent` as sent but not completed, `deleted` as dismissed.
5. Read `/vault/Tasks/tasks/*.md` directly for pending/in_progress tasks due tomorrow or in the next 7 days. Exclude completed/done/cancelled/canceled.
6. Optionally read Catthew latest output from `/home/hermes/.hermes/profiles/catthew/cron/output/c729ba85e251/` for family/Victoria fixed items.

Hard schedule constraints to preserve:
- Before 9:00 AM: baby/family, no work.
- 10:00–10:30 AM: brunch protected.
- 2:35–2:45 PM: pickup transition.
- Around 2:45 PM: pick up Victoria / family transition.
- Deep work only between 9:00 AM and 2:45 PM, excluding brunch.
- Company review rotation: Monday SalonX, Tuesday Sans Souci/SS, Wednesday Ongles Rivieres, Thursday Ongles Maily, Friday Ongles Charlesbourg. Weekends: no Company Review; use Investment Portfolio Review instead.
- Weekends: do not include Pomodoro Schedule in the morning briefing, and Zeus schedule-reminder scripts stay silent. Show only Fixed, Today Tasks, Review Block, Top 3, Decisions if needed.

Output compact Telegram-readable plaintext:

Tomorrow Prep — YYYY-MM-DD

Review Block
- 11:45–12:15 — [Company Review on weekdays; Investment Portfolio Review on weekends]

Carry Forward?
- [unfinished from today only if genuinely still pending/sent]

Candidate Top 3
1. ...
2. ...
3. ...

Admin / Finance Batch
- ...

No-Date Triage
- [max 3: schedule / backlog / delete?]

Need Duy Decision
- [omit if none]

Rules:
- Do not shame or dump backlog.
- Max 3 candidate priorities.
- Ask for decisions only when necessary.
- Strip Obsidian markup: `[[Page|label]]` -> `label`, remove raw tags/brackets.
- Unfinished deep work should be rescheduled into tomorrow's realistic blocks, not repeated endlessly.

jobs.name: Time-Blocked Obsidian Task Card Drip
jobs.prompt: Script-only job. Every 5 minutes during Duy's weekday work window, run planned_task_drip.py. The script regenerates today's /vault/Tasks/planning/YYYY-MM-DD.md from theduyvault tasks, sends Telegram cards only at approved time-block windows (9:00 setup, 9:10 deep work, 10:30 deep work, 11:45 company review, 12:15 admin/finance, 13:00 deep work, 14:15 shutdown), and stays silent outside windows. It respects protected time: no work before 9:00, brunch 10:00-10:30, pickup transition 14:35-14:45, family after 14:45.

jobs.name: Generate Daily Time-Blocked Plan
jobs.prompt: Script-only job. Generate today's time-blocked planning note from theduyvault tasks before Duy's 9AM work window. Writes /vault/Tasks/planning/YYYY-MM-DD.md using approved constraints: no work before 9AM, brunch 10:00-10:30, pickup transition 14:35-14:45, Victoria/family after 14:45, company review rotation Monday SalonX, Tuesday SS, Wednesday Ongles Rivieres, Thursday Ongles Maily, Friday Ongles Charlesbourg; weekends use Investment Portfolio Review instead of Company Review and no Pomodoro schedule. Delivery local only.

jobs.name: Sync Obsidian Tasks to theduy Calendar
jobs.prompt: Script-only job. Sync dated eligible Obsidian task files from /vault/Tasks/tasks/*.md to Google Calendar `theduy calendar` only (calendar ID duynt1989@gmail.com). Exclude any task tagged or mentioning catthew/#catthew. Exclude completed/done/cancelled/canceled. Upsert events using source file extendedProperties and delete stale events managed by this script. Stay silent except for script stdout saved locally.

jobs.name: Import theduy Calendar Task Events to Obsidian
jobs.prompt: Script-only job. Import explicitly-prefixed Google Calendar events from `theduy calendar` (duynt1989@gmail.com) into Obsidian task files under /vault/Tasks/tasks. Only import events whose title starts with `Task:` or `TODO:`. Ignore normal appointments, ignore Zeus's own Obsidian->Calendar mirror events, and ignore #catthew/catthew events. Mark imported Google events with private extendedProperties for idempotency. Stay silent except for script stdout saved locally.

jobs.name: Due-Today Obsidian Task Card Drip
jobs.prompt: Script-only job. Every 10 minutes during Duy's active day, send at most one Telegram card for a pending/in-progress non-catthew Obsidian task in /vault/Tasks/tasks with due_date exactly today. Do not drip overdue tasks; Duy moves overdue items himself while planning. Source of truth is the task Markdown file; Done button callback zt:<digest> must mark that original file completed via Zeus task_buttons registry.

jobs.name: Daily Pomodoro Schedule Reminders
jobs.prompt: Script-only job. Run send_daily_schedule_reminder.py every 5 minutes; the script stays silent except inside configured Vancouver/Pacific weekday reminder windows, and stays fully silent on weekends. Sends a plain one-line Pomodoro schedule reminder only, e.g. '🗓 9:05–9:30 — Pomodoro 1 — Deep Work'. No checkboxes, no task list, no buttons. Task cards with Done buttons are handled separately by due_task_drip.py. Specific-time events/tasks must not be fed into Pomodoro reminders.

jobs.name: Quarterly Major Earnings Reminder Import
jobs.prompt: Script-only quarterly job. Fetch the major US-listed stock earnings schedule plus every ticker in Duy's watchlist from /vault/System/Stock Watchlist.md, then create Obsidian task reminders in /vault/Tasks/tasks via fetch_major_earnings_reminders.py. Run at the beginning of January, April, July, and October. The script is idempotent; it creates one earnings reminder per major/watchlist ticker/date, with due_time/session metadata so specific-time events stay fixed and are not fed into Pomodoro reminders.
